metadata.title: Distribution Group SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing institutional distribution groups used for controlled one-to-many human email communication.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, records, and acceptable use baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional email distribution groups supporting controlled one-to-many message delivery to defined internal audiences, with strict posting and membership governance.

information-type.title: Distribution Group Email Content
information-type.description: Email messages distributed to group members.

information-type.title: Distribution Group Membership Data
information-type.description: Membership rosters defining recipients of distributed messages.

information-type.title: Posting Authorization and Audit Data
information-type.description: Records of who is authorized to post and all posting events.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Distribution groups inherit Individual Email SSPP constraints for sender identity, monitoring, disclosure, and data classification.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Distribution groups are implemented on the Secure Email Platform.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: Distribution groups provide controlled internal broadcast messaging by humans to defined audiences.

props.name: communication-model
props.remarks: Messages originate from an individual sender and are delivered to multiple recipients.

props.name: posting-model
props.remarks: Posting is restricted to explicitly authorized senders; open posting is prohibited.

props.name: membership-governance
props.remarks: Distribution group membership must be explicitly managed and reviewed by an assigned group owner.

props.name: volume-constraint
props.remarks: Distribution groups MUST NOT be used for bulk, mass, or campaign-style messaging.

props.name: escalation-requirement
props.remarks: When message scope or frequency exceeds distribution group norms, escalation to the Email Campaign Platform is required.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Distribution groups MUST NOT be used by applications or automated systems.

props.name: external-recipient-policy
props.remarks: Distribution groups MUST contain only institutional recipients; external recipients are prohibited.

props.name: external-forwarding
props.remarks: Forwarding rules are enforced at individual mailbox level; distribution groups do not control forwarding behavior.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Distribution groups MUST NOT be used for information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: authority-scope
props.remarks: Distribution group messages do not convey institutional approval or decision authority unless validated via a separate workflow.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All messages distributed via distribution groups MUST be attributable to the originating individual sender.

props.name: disclosure-authority
props.remarks: Disclosure of distribution group content occurs only under lawful or formally authorized institutional processes.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Distribution groups are restricted to institutional recipients only, including students, staff, faculty, librarians, and affiliates. External recipients are explicitly prohibited.

props.name: membership-constraint
props.remarks: Distribution group membership MUST consist solely of institutional identities associated with students, staff, faculty, librarians, or affiliates. External addresses, contacts, or mail-enabled guests are not permitted.

props.name: nesting-constraint
props.remarks: Distribution groups may only contain other distribution groups that themselves meet the internal-only membership requirement.

system-implementation.remarks: Distribution group trust is enforced through posting restrictions, membership governance, sender attribution, and centralized monitoring.

components.title: Email Distribution Group
components.description: Institutional one-to-many email distribution group with restricted posting and managed membership.

roles.title: Distribution Group Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for group purpose, membership, posting authorization, and lifecycle.

roles.title: Authorized Distribution Group Sender
roles.remarks: Individual authorized to post to the distribution group.

control-implementation.remarks: All security and privacy controls are inherited from Individual Email SSPP and Secure Email Platform SSPP, with additional posting and membership constraints.
